name: Ria
message: 「Synn, are you sure you don't need any help?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, once we put this away, we're all done♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haa--I'm beat. Let's hurry home so I can watch Wangan Big Boys」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh my, Nanaka, you actually enjoy such vulgar dramas?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Didn't expect that. So you watch it too, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「I do not watch a drama where all they ever show is Hamburg steaks!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Last week left off on a cliffhanger where their beef got seized--like, what's gonna happen next?!」

name: Ria
message: 「I bet they'll substitute it with pork or something.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ever since a friend recommended it to me and said it was fun, I guess.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You must really love Hamburg steaks too, Senpai♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's not why... I mean, I do like them, though\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It must be a super popular drama~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. Having dramatic everyday moments is more than enough for me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Your TV just doesn't get any reception, does it?」

name: Ria
message: 「Oops. If we keep chatting, we'll miss it」

name: Girl
message: 「Look, look! Look at that! With that much stuff around, there's gotta be something tasty too, right!!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's already dark and dangerous out here. You need to hurry on home, okay?」

name: Girl
message: 「Grrr. Quit treating me like a kid!!」

name: Girl
message: 「You think getting down to eye level will make me listen to you, don't you!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, it makes it easier to talk to you...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm Synn Sakura, president of the Ryuusei Student Council. Nice to meet you」

name: Girl
message: 「This is the chance I've been waiting for!! Now's the time to settle our daily 'Ooh-la-la~\s04' grudge!!」

name: Girl
message: 「No way!! My sexy attack didn't work!?」

name: Girl
message: 「I can't forgive you for making a fool of me!!」

name: Girl
message: 「When we're up against that detestable Student Council, there's no need for mercy or hesitation!! Let's steal all the yummy food!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah...! That girl... she's the Demon who showed up before when we were eating meat buns!」

name: Sally
message: 「That's right!! Known far and wide as the legendary idol of the Demon World, I am none other than Sally-chan!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We don't even know anything about the Demon World in the first place」

name: Sally
message: 「Then I'll just stamp my name right onto those chests of yours with a *pon*!!」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't really get what's going on, but things have gotten pretty crazy, huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This isn't the time to be looking at things objectively, Senpai. At a time like this--」

name: Ria
message: 「It's time for the Crusaders to shine, right♪」
